meta.title: 大白兔白又白
meta.description: Dabaitu look pack: the sidebar brand becomes the steamed-bun mascot with 「大白兔白又白」, the whole UI becomes an eye-friendly warm paper palette with a paper-grain overlay, and a 「截图」/「豆包」 pair in the app shell's top bar takes a drag-select screenshot or opens doubao.com inside the app.
